title: Forward copying phase
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word and let $j$ be a natural number with $j\le |x|$. After $j$ steps from its initial configuration on input $x$, the raw marker-stripping machine is in state $0$, has copied the first $j$ bits of $x$ to its work tape, has its input head at position $j+1$ and work-tape head at position $j$, and has emitted no output.
replaced:
For every $j \le \abs{x}$, after $j$ steps from its initial configuration on
input $x$ the stripping machine holds the first $j$ bits of $x$ on its work
tape with both heads advanced by $j$, and has emitted nothing.
